environment.cold_definition: fresh Python process; OS page cache and previously built native engines retained
environment.rss_method: 10ms /proc process-tree samples (lower bound); Linux kernel lifetime ru_maxrss per interpreter/completed child

method.RSS: external 10ms /proc tree samples; may miss spikes and count shared pages twice; not an upper bound
method.codec: same four objects; one unmeasured roundtrip then alternating five paired repetitions by default
method.codec_timing_scope: complete existing API costs, including semantic validation performed by each codec; not isolated bit-packing speed
method.cold: fresh Python process; OS page cache retained; imports and file reads included in process wall
method.kernel_RSS: worker lifetime ru_maxrss, not an isolated phase peak
method.machine_isolation: single benchmark worker at a time; unrelated host work and CPU frequency not controlled
method.restore: same persisted objects; fresh process for JSON and compact; cached extract reads no entropy; re-sign uses fresh SecureRandom
method.service: raw backend and standalone object snapshots; FixedIssuer locks/fsync unchanged and not benchmarked
method.statistics: within-run phase medians, then descriptive summaries across independent roots; failures retained
method.warm: same backend/root/key; existing scalar component cache; Schur plans rebuilt by unchanged backend
